reply_text:
I told Hollis the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is **84 seats**, in a reply to his message in #central-team.

Tobias first posted 382 in #central-team on Oct 14. Later that day he corrected it in #central-random, saying he'd read the wrong line and the real figure is 84. I read that message myself before answering. Hollis is a member of both channels, so he could see both posts himself. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the team channel.

The knowledge base still holds both figures, the old 382 and the corrected 84, and nothing marks the first one as replaced. Anyone looking it up later could get the wrong number. If you want, I can remove the 382 entry so only the corrected one is left.
